roles.name: --border
roles.purpose: frames and lines: a frame on a resting container and the splits between its sections, a line on controls and between rows

roles.name: --border-subtle
roles.purpose: dividers inside a container

roles.name: --card
roles.purpose: a resting container that holds content, framed by a frame border

roles.name: --card-foreground
roles.purpose: text on a card

roles.name: --gap-figures
roles.purpose: headline figures side by side in a readout row
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --line-height-body
roles.purpose: prose, rows, labels and controls
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --line-height-caption
roles.purpose: the smallest type roles: metadata, badges, field errors, nav items, the status strip
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --line-height-display
roles.purpose: the heading a screen opens with
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --muted-foreground
roles.purpose: secondary text — hints, metadata. L .50 is the lightest that clears WCAG AA (4.5:1) on every surface muted text sits on, muted and accent included

roles.name: --primary
roles.purpose: the brand fill: the one primary action per view, the active nav item

roles.name: --primary-ink
roles.purpose: the brand colour as TEXT or a glyph on a surface — a link, a record's mark. The fill above carries white text; in dark it is too deep to read as text itself, so this lifts it.

roles.name: --primary-muted
roles.purpose: a quiet brand tint — a selected row, a panel's header band, and the default badge's fill

roles.name: --radius-container
roles.purpose: a container that HOLDS content: a card, a dialog, a menu

roles.name: --radius-control
roles.purpose: a thing that IS content: a button, a field, a nav item

roles.name: --step-12
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --step-14
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --step-24
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --tracking-title
roles.purpose: the tightened tracking of the title roles — screen and browse titles

roles.name: --weight-body
roles.purpose: running text, cells, hints, metadata
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --weight-emphasis
roles.purpose: a column heading, a field error, a nav group, the status strip, a table footer
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --weight-heading
roles.purpose: a card or section heading, a readout caption, a figure, initials
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --weight-title
roles.purpose: screen and browse titles only
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: border-frame
roles.purpose: The two line roles — every border is one of them, by its job. A frame is a container's edge and the splits and header bands between its sections. A line is a control's edge, an overlay's edge, and the rules between rows or items.

roles.name: type-body
roles.purpose: prose — descriptions, list text, dialog text
roles.value: font-size: var(--step-14); font-weight: var(--weight-body); line-height: var(--line-height-body)
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: type-readout-caption
roles.purpose: names the value beneath it on a readout or a facet tile
roles.value: font-size: var(--step-12); font-weight: var(--weight-heading); line-height: var(--line-height-caption)
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: type-screen-title
roles.purpose: the heading a screen opens with — a form, a record, a landing page
roles.value: font-size: var(--step-24); font-weight: var(--weight-title); line-height: var(--line-height-display); letter-spacing: var(--tracking-title)
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.
